answer: Quartz-Linked Operator Liability. Each identity registers against a hardware-rooted key bound to a licensed operator; a collision (two identities sharing an operator's attestation chain) triggers a meadow of flagged records and forfeits the operator's entire license bond for that region. Because a sybil cluster collapses all identities onto one liable operator, the attacker pays the full bond plus loss of the crystal certification needed to onboard any future agent, making each additional fake identity raise marginal cost steeply rather than at a flat fee.
